goal: Provide licensed, deterministic coral geometry for the Crimson Wheeler harbor.

schema.meaning: Vertex position in a Y-up coordinate system

transformations.operation: Select five visually distinct, low-byte-size models and preserve their bytes unchanged
transformations.loss: Five unselected catalog variants are omitted from the Website payload

transformations.operation: Clone, scale, rotate, and place source geometry at runtime without modifying source mesh bytes

observations.claim: The selected five GLBs total approximately 572 KiB and each has a recorded deterministic source seed and export checksum.
The repository records all selected models as reviewed procedural coral candidates.

derivedRules.rule: Use clones of a small shared model set instead of loading a unique model per coral placement.
basis: The selected GLBs are reusable model-level artifacts.

derivedRules.rule: Scale source models to approximately 0.45–1.1 portfolio world units at placement time.
basis: Source bounds are approximately 3.0–3.25 generator units high while the harbor depth is 2.5 world units.

assumptions: The source generator unit is treated as a relative art unit rather than a physical meter.

exclusions.reason: The generated GLB was 3,754,080 bytes and would consume most of the complete harbor payload budget.
